programs.d: Bringing the best in cinema.
Arjun moves to town to pursue his studies and fulfil his brother's wish. He nevertheless becomes caught up in the rivalry of corrupt politicians.
Jai, an easy-going man, is his father's biggest worry as he wants him to get married and become more responsible. However, things change after he meets Avni, an ambitious MBA graduate.
While struggling to find work, Sanya accepts a unique job and ends up leading a quiet revolution in how her community thinks about health and responsibility.
Tarun and Namrata move into a luxurious bungalow with Taman and Nimmi, their son and daughter respectively. However, strange occurrences start taking place and they must escape in order to survive.
When a slew of sex workers disappear, Arjun, a former police officer, is brought in to crack the case. Subsequently, as he works undercover with Reshma, a young prostitute, she too disappears.
Surya, a young boy, is born with a rare condition and cannot feel pain, so he decides to learn martial arts and catch criminals.
Uday Gupta, a medical student, the only male in the gynaecology department of a medical college, ends up in a series of hilarious situations due to his hesitance.
Former cricketer Mahendra marries Mahima, a doctor with a passion for cricket. However, upon discovering her exceptional skills, he encourages her to pursue a professional career in the sport.
A woman is forced to abandon her Bollywood dreams after her boyfriend sells her to a brothel. As time passes, she builds strong connections in the criminal underworld and rises to power.
When an anchor, Arun, who is down on his luck, blames God for his misfortunes, God decides to give him his powers for ten days. Soon chaos ensues when Arun decides to grant everyone's wishes.

After gaining the power of invisibility, Raghu becomes a vigilante in order to take revenge on those who have wronged him and his lover.

Jethalal and Daya are in a romantic mood and wear old clothes but are embarrassed when everybody watches them. Champaklal and Tapu visit a remote temple.
When Daya spills tea on Jethalal's cheque, he gets irate and scolds her. He later realises his mistake and calls home but gets no reply.
Having insulted Daya's family earlier, Jethalal is now petrified of the consequences. Later, he rushes back home to apologise to Daya.
Jethalal is unable to talk to Daya. Later, Babita tells a shocked Bhide how Jethalal is acting weird and throwing stones at everyone.
Sodhi finally breaks the door to Jethalal's house and everyone rushes in to see Daya. However, Jethalal gets a shock to see her in bed and thinks that she has died.
The members of Gokuldham society are busy celebrating Diwali. Meanwhile, Tappu receives a lot of money as blessings from the elders.
Sundar comes to wish the Gada family on the occasion of Diwali. However, all is not as it seems as Sundar has something else on his mind.
Sundar tries to convince Jethalal of his scheme, but Jethalal lies about not having enough money to finance the operation. Soon, Sundar feels disappointed and returns to Ahmedabad.
Jethalal decides to buy another house in Gokuldham society. Meanwhile, Bhide decides to sell the same house to Roshan.
As Jethalal fails to persuade Champaklal and Daya, the duo prepares for Tapu's wedding. Finally, the baraat reaches the bride's home, where Jethalal meets Tapu's in-laws.
Jethalal and Roshan both give the token amounts to Bhide for the same house. Soon, Bhide is stressed when neither side decides to back out.
Bhide finds himself in a fix about whom to sell the house to and ends up arguing with his wife in the process. Meanwhile, Daya tries to convince Jethalal not to buy the house.
Bhide explains the entire scenario and his conflict to Mr Chandaramani. Soon, Mr Chandaramani suggests a way out of the problem.
Everyone is happy with Mr Chandaramani's suggestion of auctioning the flat. Soon, they wait for the owner to arrive so that the auction can begin.
Society members have an idea to handle the summer heat by putting water vessels all around for animals. Tapu Sena takes responsibility for the process.
While walking to their society, Gokuldham members see workers labouring in the sunlight without water and decide to help them.
Determined to help the workers, Tapu Sena asks Roshan to make buttermilk and set up a stall nearby to offer the drink to them.
Roshan informs the other ladies about Tapu Sena's charitable activities. Taarak compliments Tapu Sena on their kindness.

Early in the morning, Jethalal has to endure Sundar at the breakfast table. To add to his woes, Sundar's group of friends arrive unexpectedly. A starving Jethalal wonders what else lies ahead for him.
Sundar tries to convince Jethalal to buy a plot from his friend. Sundar, Tapu and his friends go to the beach and have a great time. Jetha accidentally gets locked inside his own storeroom.
Jethalal accidentally drops his phone into the toilet. He is horrified to realise that he has been locked in the storeroom. Daya begins to worry about Jethalal.
Daya learns from Natu Kaka that Jethalal has left for the airport. Just as Jethalal begins to curse his luck, two thieves break into his storeroom.
The thieves threaten to harm Jethalal unless he helps them steal. Fortunately, cops arrive in time and nab the culprits. But Jethalal's luck runs out when the cops mistake him for a thief.
The Gadas meet Pandeyji to seek his help. Jethalal convinces the cop to call his family.
Champaklal, Daya, Sundar and Tapu spot the thieves stealing from Jethalal's storeroom. They use their ingenuity to nab the culprits.
When they hear about Jethalal's ordeal, all members complain to Daya as to why she did not inform them. Jethalal is angered on seeing Sundar's friends and asks who answered the phone earlier.
After taking his clothes, the thieves threaten Jethalal into helping them carry the stolen goods. Soon, things take a turn for the worse when the cops arrive and arrest Jethalal.
Jethalal is relieved to see Sunder leave. Meanwhile, Nathu Kaka makes Jethalal realise that his troubles were a blessing in disguise since they could nab the thieves.
The residents of a housing society help each other find solutions when they face common real-life challenges and get involved in sticky situations.
On one hand, Jethalal worries over the visitor and on the other, the gangster's wife threatens him to save her brother.
A man secretly attempts to obtain information on Jethalal. Later, the Cops want Daya to testify against the gang.
Jethalal hesitantly agrees to let Daya testify against the gang. Goons come and threaten Daya. Jethalal is worried about the safety of his family.
Everyone is tense when Daya gets a threatening phone call. Later, the cops decide to provide security for Daya and her family.
Jethalal disguises himself in order to get some urgent work done. However, he suddenly gets kidnapped by the goons.
Daya somehow manages to rescue Jethalal from the goons in her unique way. Later, the gangster plans to kidnap Daya.
While the Police keep a strict vigil on the Gada family, the gangster's brother-in-law tries to intimidate the cops.
The members of the society show concern and offer their support to the Gadas. Later, the gangster's wife pressurises him.
In the morning, Sodhi offers to take Tapu to his school. Meanwhile, the gangsters devise an infallible plan to kidnap Daya.
The police officers and the gangsters engage in a firing match when they visit Dr Hathi under a false pretext.
Daya expresses her gratitude toward Jethalal for saving her from the kidnappers. Later, she is determined to testify.
